scene: The funicular glides upward as glowing neon signs shrink below the glass.
beats: Inside lies a brass star-wheel dial. The carriage clunks to a halt at the Comet Watch Rooftop, and you step out under starry skies.
The ceiling glass tints purple to reveal faint constellations. The funicular docks smoothly, letting you out beside steaming cocoa robots on the rooftop.
The robot wakes with a chime, handing you a punchcard comet schedule before the doors slide open onto the breezy Comet Watch Rooftop.
picture: Flat side view inside the tilted glass-walled funicular. On the far left sits an embroidered velvet pouch on a green velvet bench. The player stands centre with telescope slung. Up high, an ornate brass dial glows. On the far right, a tin conductor robot naps against the exit door.
shown: a mysterious embroidered velvet pouch sitting on an empty seat on the left
an ornate brass cabin dial glowing softly on the wall up high
a sleeping robot conductor wearing a pillbox cap on the far right
